recipes.title: Recipes

spoonacular.title: Import from Spoonacular
spoonacular.intro: Search Spoonacular for a recipe or paste a URL/ID. After import, every field is editable.
spoonacular.pasteIntro: If you have a Spoonacular link or recipe ID.
spoonacular.previewIntro: Spoonacular returns English only. The German fields stay empty and can be filled in via the Refine action.

llm.title: Import a recipe with AI
llm.intro: Describe the recipe you want to save. The AI will structure it; you can edit every field afterwards.
llm.promptPlaceholder: e.g. "Quick pad thai for 4 with tofu and peanuts"
llm.previewIntro: Review and edit the fields below, then save.

refine.title: Refine with AI
refine.intro: Describe a change, e.g. "make this vegetarian" or "halve the salt". Changed fields will be highlighted.

titles.intro: At least one language is required.

classification.title: Classification

ingredients.title: Ingredients
ingredients.intro: Type a name to see suggestions from the catalog. Unknown names are auto-added to the catalog on save.
ingredients.servingsUnapplied: Amounts are currently for {applied} servings. Click Scale to rescale proportionally, or leave as-is to change the portion size.
ingredients.name: Name

components.title: Components
components.intro: References to other recipes. On display, ingredients and steps are rolled up.

steps.title: Steps
steps.intro: One step per row. Both languages optional, at least one per step.
